title: The feed renders a closeout's DONE_WITH_CONCERNS answer as 'answered failed (no-commits)'
body: Recorded in tick 54n's own notes (2026-09-15 09:23) as worth a separate look: attempt 13's role_result said DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, but collect classified the attempt as failed on no-commits and the feed line read 'closeout-epic answered failed (no-commits)' — as though the worker declared failure. For a role whose deliverable is a report plus findings, no commits may be the correct shape, and the feed should not render a DONE_WITH_CONCERNS answer as 'answered failed'. The gap between a role's own status and the run's verdict needs a decided rule, not an incidental one.
